verdict.rationale: Supermemory publishes a documented public API with endpoints for adding, searching, listing/updating/deleting memories and documents, plus official TypeScript and Python client libraries and code examples (add/search calls, container tags, customId updates). This is clearly a first-party, documented API rather than just a UI, matching the ai-native driving-the-product story. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI/Swagger endpoints all 404'd per probe) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of API usage beyond vendor docs.
